visitHistory.heading: What I already knew when you opened this
visitHistory.lede: None of this came from your browser — it came from this site's own visit history. You clicked nothing, accepted no banner, and nothing was written to your machine. Every one of these is true right now:

fact.firstEver: You're the first person ever to open this page.
fact.firstFromCity: You're the first person from {{city}} ever to open this page.
fact.firstFromCityInDays: You're the first person from {{city}} in {{days}} days.
fact.milestone: You're exactly the {{position}} person to open this page.
fact.recent24h: You're the {{position}} person here in the last 24 hours.
fact.previous: The last person before you arrived from {{previousCity}}, {{when}}.
fact.position: You're the {{position}} person to open this page.

visitHistory.note: The line at the top of this page picks one of these at a time, and a reload moves to the next. What's kept from your visit is a country, a city, an approximate coordinate and a timestamp — no IP, not because it was scrubbed but because the event that crosses this system has no field for one.

liveProof.heading: Watch it happen
liveProof.description: A live slice of the same system behind this page: real visitors, real locations, streaming in as they happen.

livePanel.heading: Live dashboard
livePanel.description: Every metric, the live map, recent visits, and the raw event stream — the full panel behind the numbers on the home page.

arch.caption: The request pipeline behind this page, live: your browser holds a SignalR connection through the API, presence and geolocation flow through Redis, events queue on RabbitMQ for the worker, and everything lands in Postgres.
